jobs.title: Program Manager (French speaking)
jobs.jd_full:
Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable)

Location: Remote, based in Sub-Saharan Africa (Africa time zones)

Language Requirements: French fluency required

Reports to: Head of Growth

OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and digital workflows so that governments and NGOs can deliver public services more efficiently, achieve interoperability across fragmented systems, and scale critical public services across health, humanitarian, and government programs.

Our team, Open Function Group, the primary steward of this open-source platform, is a lean, fully-remote team of integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 40+ countries.

We are not making marginal improvements to already comfortable lives. We are building the infrastructure that allows governments to function, clinics to operate, and vulnerable populations to access services they depend on.

The role

We need a remote, relationship-driven, commercially-minded Program Manager who is genuinely technically fluent, someone who can speak credibly about our platform, integrations, and data workflows with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, to keep our existing customers happy, engaged, and growing, and to help us stand up program management as a function for the very first time.

We are hiring our first Program Manager to own and grow relationships with OpenFn’s existing customers as we transition to a subscription model built around packaged product-and-services bundles.

As our first Program Manager in this market, you will own the full portfolio of existing subscription customers and be accountable for their retention, satisfaction, and growth. You will be the trusted advisor customers turn to, the person who makes sure they are getting real value from OpenFn, and the internal owner of the commercial health of each account.

OpenFn is a genuinely technical product: our customers use it to build integrations, move data between systems, and automate complex digital workflows. You do not need to be an engineer, and you will not be doing hands-on implementation work; we have solution architects and implementation consultants for that. But you do need to be technically fluent: able to understand how customers use the platform, hold a credible conversation with their technical teams, spot when something is going wrong, and know when to bring in a specialist. That technical credibility is what will make you a genuine trusted advisor rather than just a point of contact.

Because this is a foundational hire, you will both build and execute. You will not inherit a mature playbook; you will help create it, establishing the processes, cadences, and tooling that a strong program management function depends on, while carrying a live book of business from day one.

Own & grow customer relationships

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of existing subscription customers
  • Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across each customer organization, from day-to-day users through to senior decision-makers
  • Develop and maintain account plans that map each customer’s objectives to the value OpenFn delivers
  • Plan and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other regular check-ins

Bring technical fluency to the relationship

  • Develop a strong working understanding of the OpenFn platform and how each of your customers uses it
  • Hold credible, substantive conversations with customers’ technical teams about their integrations, data workflows, and use cases
  • Translate fluently between customers’ technical staff and their non-technical decision-makers
  • Spot technical adoption risks early, and know when to bring in solution architects or implementation consultants

Drive retention & expansion

  • Own gross and net retention for your portfolio, and be accountable for renewals
  • Forecast renewals accurately and manage the end-to-end renewal process
  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and lead recovery plans before they churn
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to grow accounts, including tier upgrades and cross-sell of additional services
  • Negotiate renewals and expansions in line with our pricing and packaging model

Deliver value & coordinate delivery

  • Ensure a smooth handoff from sales and implementation into ongoing program management
  • Monitor product usage and adoption, and work with customers to close gaps and deepen engagement
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, channeling feedback to our product and services teams
  • Coordinate with support and implementation teams to meet SLA commitments and deliver project-based work
  • Manage escalations, bringing the right internal people together to resolve issues quickly

Build the program management function

  • Establish the playbooks, cadences, and health-scoring approach that will let program management scale as OpenFn grows
  • Maintain accurate account data, activity, and forecasts in our CRM, and report on core retention/growth metrics to leadership
  • Help migrate existing customers from legacy project-based arrangements onto the new subscription model

Required Qualifications

  • 3-7+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related customer-facing commercial role at a SaaS or subscription business
  • A proven track record of retaining and growing a portfolio of customers, including owning renewals, forecasting, and driving upsell or expansion
  • Experience managing customers for a technically substantive product, with a demonstrated ability to get up to speed on how a product actually works
  • Genuine technical fluency: comfort discussing concepts such as APIs, integrations, data exchange, and workflow automation, and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to earn trust with both technical users and senior stakeholders
  • Experience running customer cadences such as QBRs, service reviews, and success planning
  • Hands-on proficiency with a CRM, and a data-informed approach to managing account health and forecasts
  • Fluent, professional-level English and French communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to work effectively across a distributed, multicultural team
  • A self-starter mindset suited to a foundational role where you build as well as execute, and the ability to work from home or a shared office space with fast, stable internet, preferably in a country located in Sub-Saharan Africa (Africa time zones)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience helping a business (or its customers) transition from project or services-based revenue to a subscription model

  • A technical background (e.g. a computer science degree, or prior experience in engineering, technical support, solutions, or implementation), including hands-on experience with integration tooling, data pipelines, or APIs

  • Experience managing government, NGO, public sector, or other international customers, ideally within the digital public goods or open source ecosystem

  • Working knowledge of CRMs such as Salesforce or Odoo

  • Additional language skills relevant to our customer base (e.g. Spanish, Portuguese)

  • Experience selling and/or delivering complex digital transformation, business process transformation, or data integration projects

  • Financial compensation includes a base salary plus variable pay tied to the retention and growth (upsell and expansion) of your portfolio. Total pay is commensurate with experience, per OpenFn’s Equal Pay for Equal Work framework; the detailed variable-pay mechanics are shared during the interview process.

  • N.B.: Selling to NGO and government customers, we don’t offer Silicon Valley pay scales, but high quality of life and fair, transparent, and competitive compensation is important to us.

  • Flexible working schedule

  • We’re fully remote, with team meetups across Europe and Africa (our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar)

  • Exposure to the hottest industry and technology trends and leading health, humanitarian, and government digital transformation interventions in the sector

  • Opportunity for leadership and advancement; you will be a key contributor to our company’s strategy and direction

  • The opportunity to shape our strategy and impact millions of lives through our open source software in a small, mission-driven organization

jobs.title: Implementation Project Manager (WMS & TMS)
jobs.jd_full:
Implementation Project Manager (WMS/TMS)

Location: Remote – United States

Department: Professional Services / Implementation

Salary Range: $95,00–$115,000 annually

About ShipHawk

ShipHawk is a leading provider of warehouse and transportation management software, helping businesses streamline fulfillment operations, optimize shipping, and scale efficiently. Our technology empowers companies to simplify complex logistics processes and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We’re a growing team of passionate problem-solvers who thrive on collaboration, innovation, and delivering meaningful results for our customers.

About the Role

We’re looking for an experienced, highly organized, and customer-focused Implementation Project Manager to join our team.

In this role, you’ll lead end-to-end implementations of ShipHawk’s Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Transportation Management System (TMS) solutions, ensuring customers are set up for success from kickoff through go-live.

You’ll own multiple customer implementations simultaneously, coordinating technical resources, managing timelines, and serving as the primary point of contact throughout the implementation journey.

The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced SaaS environment, takes ownership of outcomes, and knows how to keep complex projects moving forward. You’ll be equally comfortable leading customer conversations, managing project details, and collaborating with technical teams to deliver successful implementations.

What You’ll Do

Lead Customer Implementations

  • Own and manage multiple concurrent WMS and TMS implementation projects from kickoff through successful go-live.

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverables.

  • Proactively manage dependencies, identify risks, and remove roadblocks to keep projects on track.

  • Ensure implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations.

Own Customer Communication & Relationships

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the implementation process.

  • Lead customer kickoff meetings, status updates, and project discussions with clear agendas, action items, and next steps.

  • Provide proactive, transparent communication regarding project progress, timelines, risks, and deliverables.

  • Set clear expectations and build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders.

  • Identify and escalate potential challenges early while maintaining a solutions-oriented approach.

Drive Project Execution & Accountability

  • Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date project documentation, task tracking, and status reports.

  • Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to ensure deliverables are completed on schedule.

  • Follow up on outstanding action items and drive accountability across project teams.

  • Anticipate potential delays and develop actionable contingency plans to keep implementations moving forward.

  • Balance competing priorities while maintaining strong attention to detail across multiple projects.

Partner with Technical Teams

  • Collaborate closely with Implementation Engineers, Product, and other internal teams to support successful deployments.

  • Perform or coordinate system configuration, data setup, integrations, testing, and validation activities.

  • Develop a strong understanding of ShipHawk’s WMS and TMS solutions and how they support customer operations.

  • Help troubleshoot implementation challenges by bringing together the right technical resources.

  • Ensure customers are prepared for go-live through appropriate testing, validation, and readiness activities.

Continuously Improve

  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, documentation, and customer experiences.

  • Share best practices and lessons learned across the team.

  • Contribute to scalable implementation methodologies that support ShipHawk’s continued growth.

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS implementation, technical project management, or customer-facing software delivery.

  • Proven experience managing multiple complex customer implementation projects simultaneously.

  • Strong project management skills, including planning, prioritization, risk management, and stakeholder coordination.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence leading customer-facing meetings.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a track record of meeting deadlines and driving projects to completion.

  • Comfortable working with technical concepts, software configurations, data workflows, and integrations.

  • Self-starter mentality with a high level of accountability, initiative, and ownership.

  • Ability to adapt quickly, solve problems independently, and thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), ERP platforms, or other supply chain technology.

  • Understanding of warehouse operations, order fulfillment, inventory management, shipping, or logistics workflows.

  • Experience working with APIs, EDI, system integrations, or data migration processes.

  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Asana, Jira, Monday.com, or similar platforms.

  • Experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • PMP, CSM, or other relevant project management certifications.

What Success Looks Like

  • Successful Go-Lives: Customer implementations are delivered on time, within scope, and with a smooth transition to production.

  • Strong Customer Experience: Customers feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their implementation journey.

  • Proactive Project Ownership: Risks are identified early, action items are consistently followed through, and projects continue moving forward.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Internal teams and customer stakeholders have clear expectations, responsibilities, and timelines.

  • Operational Excellence: Project documentation is accurate, deliverables are tracked, and implementation processes continuously improve.

Why Join ShipHawk?

At ShipHawk, you’ll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how businesses manage their warehouse and shipping operations. You’ll work alongside a collaborative team, solve meaningful operational challenges, and play an important role in delivering technology that helps our customers grow.

We value people who take initiative, communicate openly, embrace challenges, and take pride in delivering exceptional results.

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $95,000–$115,000 annually. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and relevant expertise.

Equal Employment Opportunity

ShipHawk is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities throughout the hiring process and employment.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Web (Part-Time, 6 Month Contract)
jobs.jd_full:
At Feeld, we are creating a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves. We are building an inclusive, human-centred product and are looking for a Product Manager to become part our remote team and our mission to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships.

You will be responsible for driving the Web product roadmap at Feeld, helping more prospective members understand the value of Feeld and successfully move from web to app.

To be right for this role, you should have experience owning and delivering web product experiences, ideally in a consumer or growth-focused environment. You’ll be comfortable working autonomously, using data to make decisions, and partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Marketing and other stakeholders to move quickly from opportunity to impact.

This is a part-time (3 days per week) and fixed term contract position (6 months).

Applications for this role will close on 19 October 2026.

What you will do:

  • Own the day-to-day product management of Feeld’s Web roadmap and backlog
  • Translate strategic priorities and growth opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design throughout discovery and delivery to define the right solution and scope
  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion across the journey from landing on Feeld’s website through to installing and joining the app
  • Work with Data to understand funnel performance, identify opportunities and establish clear success measures
  • Develop and run experiments to improve conversion, engagement and overall web performance
  • Partner with SEO, Brand and Marketing teams to ensure web experiences support acquisition campaigns, organic growth and the evolving Feeld brand
  • Maintain a clear and prioritised backlog, balancing new opportunities, optimisation, bugs and technical improvements
  • Manage dependencies, risks and trade-offs, ensuring stakeholders have visibility of progress and decisions
  • Define launch plans, monitor performance after release and use learnings to inform subsequent iterations

About you:

  • You have good Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and delivering web products or experiences
  • You have worked on consumer-facing products, ideally in a growth, marketplace, subscription or app-led environment
  • You have experience improving conversion funnels through experimentation, optimisation and data-informed decision-making
  • You are comfortable working closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing and other cross-functional partners to deliver outcomes
  • You have experience operating autonomously in fast-moving environments, quickly building context and turning opportunities into clear priorities and shipped work

About us:

Feeld is an independent, experimental and fully remote organisation reshaping the dialogue on dating and sexuality. The company was founded in 2014 and has evolved since to become the open, distributed structure it is now. We have a naturally agile and fluid culture. The whole team is fully remote, which means you work where and when helps you perform at your best. We regard autonomy highly and treat our organisation as a product – we iterate, improve and test things internally to see what works best for everyone.

Our culture:

We believe in creating a safe work environment through humanity, fluidity, safety, transparency and progressiveness. When hiring, we look for culture add rather than culture fit.

Because we are a fully remote team, it’s especially important that we create an environment where our colleagues feel included and connected as humans.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging at Feeld:

Feeld promotes open-mindedness, inclusion, diversity and kindness, both in the world and among our own workforce.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with a history of marginalisation, whether because of race, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, national origin, disability (seen or unseen) or any confluence of intersectional identities.

Our goal is a barrier-free application process and working environment. If you require further details or assistance or have any questions about this process, please let us know at hr@feeld.co.

Compensation and perks:

We are conscious of how our work and decisions impact other humans and the environment. We design our product and organisation with consideration for the wellbeing of our Members and colleagues. Feeld’s way of working is designed to proactively prevent burnout and an “always on” culture. We believe in technology and working environments that enable people to live a meaningful, fulfilled life.

Therefore, we offer our staff:

  • Flexible working hours
  • A fully remote working situation
  • On demand therapy sessions and mental health support via Spill

Our compensation system is one of the ways we work to uphold equity and inclusion at Feeld. Just as we strive to enable honest expression on our platform, we strive for openness of information within the organization. Internally, we keep decision-making transparent to keep each other accountable and make sure all voices are heard. That is why we offer a compensation system that is transparent, honest, and equitable.  Additionally, we believe all humans deserve to earn a competitive wage, so we offer a Baseline Freedom Salary of £60,000 GBP per year for any role that indexes below £60,000 GBP per year.

This is a part-time (3 days per week) and fixed term contract position (6 months).

  • Total cash compensation for this role varies by geographic location. We estimate the market-competitive compensation range for this position to be £650 GBP per day.

Our interview process:

  • Your first conversation with Feeld will be a screening call with our recruiter, where you’ll be able to ask - and receive answers - regarding any general questions you have and to confirm the role is a fit for what you’re seeking.
  • Your second conversation will connect you directly with the hiring manager for the role you’re applying to. Here, you’ll have a chance to ask more questions about the work you’ll be doing. This conversation will also focus on your past work experiences.
  • The next step for most of our roles is a candidate challenge. This is an evaluation of the skills relevant to be successful in this role and generally takes about an hour to complete.
  • Your third conversation allows you the opportunity to meet the team members you might be working with on a daily basis. Here, you’ll be able to ask questions about team processes, workflow, and the employee experience at Feeld.
  • We generally make an offer within 2 weeks of our final call, and offer a flexible start date that can begin as early as the next Monday after you sign our offer documentation.
  • Of note: all of our interviews are conducted remotely, and our interviewers will work with you to find an agreeable interview time based on mutual availability.

We understand we’re asking you to invest your time and best efforts in our process, and are appreciative of getting the chance to better know who you are as a person and candidate. In return, we’re committed to offering transparent communication and prompt feedback as you navigate this application with us.

Applications for this role will close on 19 October 2026.

To find out more about Feeld, download our app (available on iOS and Android).

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Digital Strategy | Contract | Remote, USA
jobs.jd_full:
About us:

Working at Tech Holding isn’t just a job, it’s an opportunity to be a part of something bigger. We are a full-service consulting firm that was founded on the premise of delivering predictable outcomes and high-quality solutions to our clients.  Our founders and team members have industry experience and have held senior positions in a wide variety of companies – from emerging startups to large Fortune 50 firms – and we have taken our combined experiences and developed a unique approach that is supported by the principles of deep expertise, integrity, transparency, and dependability.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, for a project based assignment, with deep experience in digital strategy, customer journeys, and conversion optimization. This person will define actionable digital acquisition roadmaps, translate business needs into functional requirements, and partner closely with engineering and analytics teams to drive execution.

The ideal candidate can move comfortably between executive-level strategy and detailed working sessions with technical teams. You should be able to analyze funnel performance directly, establish clear priorities, and design operating models that help teams manage competing requests effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and manage digital acquisition strategies and roadmaps tied to measurable business goals
  • Translate customer, business, and technical needs into clear functional requirements
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure requirements are understood, accepted, and successfully delivered
  • Analyze funnel and customer journey data to identify conversion gaps and growth opportunities
  • Work directly with analytics teams to define metrics, evaluate performance, and guide decisions
  • Facilitate working sessions with business, product, analytics, and technology stakeholders
  • Present recommendations, progress, and strategic priorities to executive leadership
  • Design intake processes, prioritization frameworks, and operating models for teams managing a high volume of requests
  • Align stakeholders around clear priorities, ownership, and execution plans
  • Track roadmap progress and adjust priorities based on data, business needs, and delivery constraints

Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience across digital strategy, customer journey optimization, product management, or conversion-focused work
  • Demonstrated experience building digital acquisition roadmaps and driving them through execution
  • Strong experience writing functional requirements that engineering teams can confidently build from
  • Ability to work directly with funnel and performance data without relying solely on prepared reports
  • Experience designing operating models, intake processes, or prioritization frameworks for high-demand teams
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate strategic recommendations clearly
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in detailed working sessions with engineering, analytics, and IT teams
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience with membership, subscription, or recurring-enrollment acquisition models
  • Experience working within nonprofit, federated, or franchise environments where national and local organizations share a customer journey
  • Experience supporting offerings with multiple participation tiers, products, or enrollment paths
  • Familiarity with youth or family audiences and the privacy requirements associated with minors

Employment Type:

  • Contract

#LI-Remote

* Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time

Tech Holding is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Web Apps
jobs.jd_full:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we’re changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

What you will be doing:

Beacon Biosignals is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the roadmap and day-to-day product decisions for our clinician- and site-facing web application, the primary way clinicians, clinical research sites, and trial teams interact with Beacon’s machine-learning-enabled brain health platform. This role reports to the Manager, Web Applications.

In this role, you’ll work within Beacon’s Web Apps team to drive major development milestones for the next generation of Beacon’s web applications for clinicians and clinical sites. You’ll shape product direction in partnership with the team’s manager and turn it into quarterly plans your team can execute against. You’ll be a clear, credible voice for the product with external users and internal stakeholders such as Beacon’s clinical, scientific, regulatory, and commercial teams.

This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates based near Beacon HQ in Boston, or another Beacon hub (e.g., New York City).

What success looks like:

  • Build deep knowledge of clinicians, sleep technicians, site coordinators, investigators, and sponsor teams, and use it to ensure the roadmap reflects their real needs and Beacon’s business goals.
  • Own a single product that serves both diagnostic and clinical trial workflows, identifying where needs overlap and diverge, and make clear, well-reasoned, documented decisions about shared versus specialized functionality.
  • Ensure the web experience is coherent with the wider ecosystem it depends on, including devices, data pipelines, ML models, and other software products. Stay informed about what adjacent teams are building, surface dependencies and conflicts early, and drive convergence so that the pieces work together as a coherent experience for users.
  • Create and evolve quarterly product roadmaps and clear requirements that your team can execute against, that shape the next generation of the web application.
  • Work closely with software engineers, product designers, and data science and machine-learning teams to align on technical specifications and feasibility, and on how model outputs are presented to users.
  • Practice continuous discovery, running formal and informal usability tests and user interviews early and often, with particular attention to the workflows of busy clinicians and site staff.
  • Deliver product requirements and changes through formal design controls in a regulated environment, using contemporary tools (at Beacon, we use Ketryx!).
  • Balance the needs of multiple customer types and internal stakeholders, including clinical operations, regulatory and quality, and commercial teams, and manage external client-facing demos that showcase the product’s current capabilities and roadmap.
  • Communicate project progress, decision-making tradeoffs, and risks with key stakeholders effectively, often, and efficiently.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, including  at least 3 years of experience managing web-based software products.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in business, engineering, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working on highly technical products, such as data platforms, analytics products, or machine-learning-enabled applications.
  • Experience working across engineering, design, and non-technical stakeholders, and balancing competing priorities among them.
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or biotech is strongly preferred, along with the ability to learn clinical context quickly.
  • Experience developing regulated software (e.g., software as a medical device or clinical trial systems) under design control (e.g. IEC 62304) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing for clinicians, clinical sites, or other expert-users is a plus.
  • Comfort and enthusiasm for using modern tools to speed up product work, such as AI-assisted drafting, analysis, and rapid prototyping. We care more about how you’ve used them than which ones.

The salary range for this role is $160,000 – $183,000. Salary ranges are determined using current market compensation data for this role and adjusted based on experience, skills, and location. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO and other benefits.

At Beacon, we’ve found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we’re always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Hi there :)

Thanks for checking in to find out about our open position. We´ll provide as much information as possible, but please feel free to reach us if you have further questions. We´ll be happy to see your application, even if there are skills you don’t quite master!

About Us

At South Geeks, we connect top-performing engineers from Latin America with global organizations building meaningful, long-term products. We focus on high-impact work, strong technical environments, and creating spaces where professionals can grow, contribute, and thrive.

About the Client

Our client builds software that helps companies drive growth at every step of the product-led growth lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, conversion and retention. Their customers reduce friction across their funnels with no-code tools, AI automation, and agents that live in their sites.

About the Role

As Senior Product Manager for the product-led growth platform, you will own the builder experience. The goal is to make it seamless for customers to build guidance flows for their most important funnels. You will use the latest AI technologies to identify points of friction in customers’ funnels, suggest improvements, build guidance, and provide tools that help end users convert at industry-leading levels.

This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Vice President, Product Management. You will work within a dedicated pod of 3 to 4 engineers, with shared access to 2 designers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for the builder experience, from discovery through delivery.

  • Talk directly to customers, identify their pain points, and synthesize them into clear product requirements, proofs of concept and roadmaps.

  • Use AI to detect friction in customer funnels and turn those signals into guidance that converts.

  • Partner with a dedicated engineering pod and shared design resources to ship and iterate.

  • Define success metrics and measure whether what ships actually moves them.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including B2B SaaS software.

  • Professional product management experience with AI-embedded products.

  • Familiarity with evals, datasets and working with AI models.

  • Technical enough to work with Git, Claude Code, and fix basic UX issues independently.

  • AI fluency: uses LLMs and agents as a force multiplier, from prototypes to requirements.

  • Comfortable starting from a blank page and overcoming ambiguity, with a bias for action.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • A traditional machine learning background: test and training data, evals, and the judgment to know that an LLM is not always the right tool.

  • Familiarity with the product-led growth customer journey for SaaS.

  • Experience leading product for MCPs, APIs or SDKs.

  • A creative, hacker spirit and a love of solving hard puzzles.

  • A track record of launching ambitious products that found distribution or commercial success.

  • Personally built or vibe-coded projects, for work or on the side.

  • Degree in business, computer science or a related field.

Our Team

We strive to create an inspiring and growth-oriented environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered. We promote both personal and professional development, with individualized support for your needs and goals. We aim to build a space where everyone can thrive.

What We Offer

  • Long-term projects

  • 100% remote work

  • Payment in USD

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Work-from-home & training reimbursement

  • English lessons

  • Technical training

  • Career coaching

jobs.title: Direct Sales Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Direct Sales Program Manager

Department: Direct Sales

Reports To: Director of Direct Sales

Location: Remote

FLSA Status: Exempt

Compensation: TBD Base Salary + Performance-Based Commission/Incentive (Target OTE: TBD)

Position Summary

The Direct Sales Program Manager is responsible for the coordination, execution, and continuous improvement of programs and initiatives supporting the Direct Sales Channel. This role helps ensure Direct-to-Door (D2D), reseller, Multi-Dwelling Unit (MDU), EMA/NEMA, and other direct sales initiatives are effectively implemented, measured, and supported across the organization.

The Program Manager serves as a key operational resource for the Direct Sales organization, working closely with the Director of Direct Sales and cross-functional teams to coordinate market initiatives, improve processes, track performance, manage program requirements, and resolve operational barriers impacting sales execution and the customer experience.

This role partners with Sales, Operations, Marketing, Construction, Customer Care, Finance, and billing to ensure Direct Sales programs are aligned, scalable, measurable, and positioned to support customer acquisition and revenue growth.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Direct Sales Program Management

  • Coordinate the planning, implementation, and ongoing management of Direct Sales programs and initiatives.
  • Support D2D, D2D resellers, MDU, EMA/NEMA, and other customer acquisition programs within the Direct Sales Channel.
  • Develop and maintain program documentation, processes, workflows, timelines, and performance tracking.
  • Coordinate program launches and market deployments with internal departments and external partners.
  • Monitor program execution and identify operational gaps, risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support the Director of Direct Sales with strategic initiatives designed to expand and strengthen the Direct Sales Channel.
  • Maintain visibility into program priorities, deliverables, progress, and outstanding action items.

Reseller & Partner Program Support

  • Support the operational management of reseller and referral partner programs.
  • Coordinate reseller onboarding, market launches, training requirements, system access, and ongoing program support.
  • Facilitate regular partner business reviews and assist with performance reporting and follow-up action items.
  • Monitor partner sales activity, connects, cancellations, sales quality, ARPU, and other applicable program metrics.
  • Coordinate reseller needs and operational requirements with internal stakeholders.
  • Help identify program opportunities that support additional market penetration and customer acquisition.

Sales Operations & Performance Analytics

  • Develop and maintain reporting used to measure Direct Sales program performance.
  • Track sales activity, connects, cancellations, conversion, ARPU, productivity, and other key performance indicators.
  • Analyze program results and identify trends, opportunities, and areas requiring additional attention.
  • Assist with sales forecasting, market planning, deployment planning, and performance reporting.
  • Prepare program updates, executive summaries, business reviews, and recommendations for Direct Sales leadership.
  • Maintain accurate program documentation and reporting to support business decisions.

MDU, EMA & NEMA Program Management

  • Coordinate Direct Sales activities associated with MDU, EMA, and NEMA programs and agreements.
  • Track properties, opportunities, program requirements, deployment status, sales activity, and results.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to support successful program implementation and ongoing execution.
  • Identify operational barriers affecting customer acquisition within participating properties or programs.
  • Support initiatives designed to increase penetration and customer acquisition within existing programs and properties.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as a liaison between Direct Sales and internal departments supporting sales execution.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Construction, Customer Care, Finance, and other stakeholders on program requirements and deliverables.
  • Facilitate communication and follow-up on issues affecting Direct Sales programs, reseller partners, field representatives, or customers.
  • Coordinate market readiness activities and help ensure sales programs are aligned with operational capabilities.
  • Maintain clear accountability for program action items, dependencies, and deliverables.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Evaluate Direct Sales workflows and recommend opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, program guidelines, job aids, and other operational documentation.
  • Support improvements to order processes, reporting, reseller workflows, market launches, and customer experience.
  • Help establish standardized processes and controls across Direct Sales programs.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to implement process changes and monitor results.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and coordinate sustainable solutions rather than relying solely on individual issue resolution.

Customer & Partner Escalation Coordination

  • Coordinate complex customer, reseller, and program-related escalations requiring cross-functional involvement.
  • Ensure appropriate stakeholders are engaged and action items are clearly documented and tracked through resolution.
  • Identify recurring escalation trends and recommend process improvements that address root causes.
  • Maintain communication with appropriate stakeholders throughout the resolution process.

Program Governance & Compliance

  • Support adherence to established Direct Sales policies, processes, contractual requirements, and sales quality standards.
  • Assist with monitoring program compliance and identifying areas requiring corrective action or process improvement.
  • Maintain program documentation and records necessary to support consistent execution.
  • Partner with appropriate stakeholders to address compliance, sales quality, and process concerns.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in program management, Direct sales operations, channel management, business operations, telecommunications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple initiatives involving cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and reporting capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into structured plans, processes, and measurable deliverables.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience coordinating issue resolution across multiple departments.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, CRM platforms, and business/sales reporting tools.
  • Ability to travel as required to support Direct Sales programs and market initiatives.
  • Bilingual is not required but preferred

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting reseller, channel, referral, or indirect sales programs.
  • Customer Service, Customer Experience, and Quality Control
  • Telecommunications, broadband, cable, or related industry experience.
  • Experience supporting Door-to-Door sales programs.
  • Experience with MDU, EMA, NEMA, or property-based sales programs.
  • Experience developing operational processes, program documentation, reporting, dashboards, or standard operating procedures.
  • Experience coordinating geographically dispersed sales programs or market launches.

Core Competencies

  • Program and project management
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Strategic execution
  • Process development and improvement
  • Data analysis and reporting
  • Partner relationship management
  • Organizational effectiveness
  • Problem solving
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Attention to detail
  • Accountability and follow-through
  • Continuous improvement

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

  • Ability to travel to assigned markets as business needs require.
  • Ability to conduct field visits, market reviews, reseller meetings, and cross-functional meetings.
  • Ability to work effectively in remote, office, and field environments.
  • Occasional evening or weekend work may be required based on business needs.
  • Valid Driver’s License.
